{{Term/Store|Red-Tusked Boar|Red-Tusked Boars|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|'''Red-Tusked Boar'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Red-Tusked Boar'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Red-Tusked Boar}}
Red-Tusked Boars are a type of [[Boar]] that commonly reside in [[Akkala]]. They are known for the black fur and red tusks, the latter of which is the source of their name.<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite|These boars are known for their red tusks and black fur. They're similar to your average boars but are considerably stronger. Extra caution is advised when hunting these.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> Red-Tusked Boars are considered to be significantly stronger than [[Woodland Boar]]s, and it is advised to be cautious while hunting them.<ref name="Compendium"/>

On occasion, Red-Tusked Boars will charge towards [[Link]] when they spot him nearby. However, they will not do so if Link is riding a [[Horse]]. More commonly, they will flee if startled. When slain, Red-Tusked Boars produce between two to three pieces of [[Raw Prime Meat]].
